content.text: Nnâmahanga Nyamubâho agashâne, ye mutungo gwâni, Ye komeza amaboko gâni oku matabâro, anayigîrize eminwe yâni okulwa.
Ye buzigire bwâni, ye mpenzi yâni, Ye lwâkiro na Muciza wâni, yêne ye kereka emirhwe oku burhegesi bwâni.
Nyamwagirwa, omuntu co cici obu omukoyakoyakwo okungan’aha? Mwene-omuntu co cici obu omushîbirira ntya?
N’obwo omuntu kwo ali nka mpûsi, ensiku zâge kwo ziri nka cizunguzungu câgera.
Nyamuzinda Nyamubâho gombya amalunga oyandagale, ohume oku ntondo zitwike mabira.
Zûsa emilazô oshandabanyemwo ababisha, ofôle obageze mihanda erhashingânana.
Nyandagaliza okuboko, ondîkûze, onyûlubule emûbi, n’okuboko kwâwe ontenze omu nfune z’ab’emahanga.
Abà akanwa karhaderha oburhali busha, n’ab’okuboko kulenzi.
Nyamwagirwa, Nyamubâho, nakuyimbira olwimbo luhyâhya, nakuzihira olulanga lwa misî ikumi.
Yâgirwa, Nyamubâho, we rhuma abâmi bahima, we wakûlaga Daudi oku bwôji bw’itumu ly’ababisha.
Nyôkola, nkûla omu maboko g’ab’emahanga, ab’akanwa karhaderha oburhali bulenzi, n’ab’amaboko gakola amaligo.
Ecabona bagala bîrhu bayûshûsire nka mburho enazire omu busole bwâbo, na bâli bîrhu nka mitungo minjinjà na mibinje nka nkingi z’omu bwâmi bwa Nyamuzinda.
Nazo enguli zîrhu ziyunjule na ngasi lubero lwa myâka, omu malambo gîrhu ebibuzi bîrhu biyôloloke.
Enkafu zîrhu ziburhane, rhurhanazimbagwa erhi kunyagwa, ntyo harhabaga ndûlù omu mihanda yîrhu.
Bali bany’iragi abantu bagishirwe ntyo, bali bany’iragi abantu bajira Nyakasane nka Nyamuzinda wâbo.
